records.text: Owens said TPUSA people told her Charlie Kirk had two Telegram accounts: an American-flag account others could access and a Charlie Kirk account used with donors; she explicitly did not know whether Erika took over the former.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Yeah, it is certainly interesting. I am told by Turning Point people that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) had two Telegram accounts, one which was accessible by people around him where he would like kind of be like the fake Charlie (Charlie Kirk). Sometimes it was the real one had access to it. ... But, like, other people also had access to it and could communicate, and that's the American flag icon. And then the real Charlie (Charlie Kirk), the one that was speaking to the donors, the one that says Charlie Kirk, that we saw when he's like, "I've been left with no choice but to ban the pro-Israel cause." That, yeah, I've realized the American flag thing is interesting. I don't know if Erika (Erika Kirk) took over that account. I don't know what's going on. I believe nothing that comes from Andrew Wilson, because why would you send it to Andrew Wilson when you could send it to Andrew Kolvet?
